# telnyx_ai_test_schedule (Resource)

A schedule that runs AI test framework scenarios on a cron expression.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_ai_test_schedule" "example" {
  name               = "Nightly regression"
  crontab_expression = "0 2 * * *"
  timezone           = "UTC"
  agent              = 42
  scenarios          = [101, 102]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `crontab_expression` (String) Cron expression controlling when the job runs, in the job's timezone.

### Optional

- `agent` (Number) ID of the test agent the job belongs to.
- `execution_mode` (String) Execution mode for the test runs, such as voice, text, or sip.
- `frequency` (Number)
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `notify_on` (String) When the job sends a notification. One of `both`, `failure`, `never`, `success`.
- `personalities` (List of Number)
- `run_as_text` (Boolean) Whether the job runs scenarios as text chat rather than voice calls.
- `scenarios` (List of Number) The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `tags` (List of String)
- `timezone` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `personality` (Number)
- `scenario_ids` (List of Number) Scenario IDs the job executes.
- `scenarios_data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scenarios_data))
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--scenarios_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scenarios_data`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `personality` (Number)
- `personality_name` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_test_schedule.example <id>
```
